violation_type.code_system: Texas Administrative Code, Title 26, Ch. HRC 42
violation_type.title: HRC 42.04271 - Parent's Rights (26 TAC §HRC 42.04271 - Parent's Rights)
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation has not informed the parents of their right.

finding_variants.text: The operation has not informed the parents of their right.
The operation has not provided parents with a written copy of their rights.

Based on the information obtained, parent's rights were not provided to parents within the required timeframe, by 09/30/2023. The childcare operation did not have a receipt/acknowledgement from parent's stating that they received a copy of the parent's right. Children enrollment forms were not updated to portray receipt of acknowledgement of parent's rights.
The operation has failed to inform the parents of their right.
Two children's files out of five reviewed are missing the parent rights signature.
At the time of inspection the operation had not provided all parents with a written copy of their rights .
